summary: The note surveys the rise of GreenTech startups after the 2023 Global Climate Summit, starting with the EcoTech Alliance and the GreenSeed fund. It profiles startups in solar energy, vertical farming, plastic pollution, AI, electric vehicles and the circular economy. It also credits policy incentives such as the Green Innovation Promotion Act with boosting the sector.
one_line: Overview of GreenTech startups, their funding and policy drivers, and ventures in solar, farming, plastics, AI, EVs and circular economy since late 2023.
key_facts: On September 15, 2023, after the 2023 Global Climate Summit, a consortium led by Sienna Martinez unveiled the EcoTech Alliance to foster partnerships among environmental startups.
By November 2023, hundreds of fledgling companies had joined the EcoTech Alliance.
On October 9th, venture capitalist Ethan Clarke launched GreenSeed, a $500 million fund dedicated to startups with disruptive sustainable technologies.
Cleanalytics, founded December 3, 2023 by data scientist Emma Zhou, provides precise data analysis on environmental impact.
The Green Innovation Promotion Act (GIPA), enacted September 21, 2023, offers tax breaks to companies and consumers adopting green technologies.
Solstice Panels unveiled ultra-efficient photovoltaic cells on November 12th; CEO Lydia Freeman's manufacturing process cuts production costs by 30%.
Aerofarm Tech, founded by brothers Alex and Ryan Tanaka, unveiled a vertical farming system on January 22, 2024 that promises to reduce agricultural land use by 70%.
Biopacify launched February 4, 2024 with Harriet Ng as lead material scientist, developing a bio-degradable packaging material to replace plastic.
BioEnzymax, founded by Jane Kim and Mark Liu, announced on October 15, 2023 an enzyme that breaks down plastics at rates previously deemed impossible.
AI Green Matrix, conceived by Michael Zhang, presented on September 30, 2023 an AI platform optimizing building energy use, with potential savings of up to 40% on energy bills.

Clean Ocean Intelligence launched an initiative on January 10, 2024 using satellite imagery and drones to find pollution hotspots and deploy clean-up bots; Samantha Ortiz is its environmental strategist.
EcoDrive Motors, led by Jack Peterson, presented a battery system on March 5, 2024 that extends EV driving range by an additional 200 miles.
ReCircle Resources, founded September 15, 2023 by environmental economist Laura Wang, enables a closed-loop system with fully recyclable or upcyclable products.
